messages:
clair: Quick UX thread: rethinking the Private setup network step. Two main asks: make failures actionable for non-admins and improve accessibility.
tom: Love that. Suggest a Beginner mode with plain-language remediation and an Advanced toggle for logs.
maya: Agree. Copy idea: change 'Prerequisites' -> 'Helpful checks' and 'Retry probes' -> 'Re-run checks'. Also add 'why this matters' short blurbs under each check.
elaine: a11y: use aria-live polite for status updates, provide textual reason for failures, and trap focus in expanded help.
clair: Layout: status badge left, probe name, then CTA (help / re-run). Will prototype a compact list to reduce scrolling.
maya: I'll make a small figma change and share variants by EOD.
